# Quickstart: In-place Quotation Field Edit

**Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md) · **Plan**: [plan.md](./plan.md) · **Tasks**: tasks.md (generated by `/speckit-tasks`)

## What you're building

A per-quotation in-place Edit form reachable from the quotation row on `Application/Edit`. The applicant can change Price, Currency, ValidUntil, or SupplierBranch (same supplier only) while the Application is `Draft` or `ReturnedForChanges`. No file replacement here — that stays on the existing `Replace` endpoint.

## Run locally

```bash
dotnet run --project src/FundingPlatform.AppHost
```

This boots Aspire → SQL Server container → dacpac deploy → smtp4dev → Web. Open the Aspire dashboard URL printed in the console; click the `web` resource to reach the public landing.

## Manual walkthrough (US1)

1. Log in as `applicant@programa-semilla.test` / `Demo123!`.
2. Click **Mis solicitudes** → open any `Draft` application (or create one).
3. On `Application/Edit`, scroll to an Item card with at least one quotation row.
4. Click **Editar** on the quotation row.
5. Change the price; click **Guardar cambios**.
6. You return to `Application/Edit`; the row reflects the new price and the CRC-equivalent updates if the quote isn't in CRC.

## Where the code lives

| Concern | File |
|---|---|
| GET / POST endpoints | `src/FundingPlatform.Web/Controllers/QuotationController.cs` (`Edit` actions added after `Convert`) |
| View | `src/FundingPlatform.Web/Views/Quotation/Edit.cshtml` |
| Shared form fields partial | `src/FundingPlatform.Web/Views/Shared/_QuoteFields.cshtml` |
| Row affordances | `src/FundingPlatform.Web/Views/Application/Edit.cshtml` (under each Item card) |
| Service orchestration | `src/FundingPlatform.Application/Services/ApplicationService.cs` (`EditQuotationAsync`) |
| Branch invariant | `src/FundingPlatform.Domain/Entities/Quotation.cs` (`ChangeBranch`) |
| Cache invalidation seam | `src/FundingPlatform.Application/Abstractions/Comparison/IComparisonCacheInvalidator.cs` + `src/FundingPlatform.Infrastructure/Comparison/ComparisonCacheInvalidator.cs` |

## Tests

```bash
# Unit (domain invariants)
dotnet test tests/FundingPlatform.Tests.Unit --filter "FullyQualifiedName~Quotation_ChangeBranchTests"

# Integration (service orchestration: state gate, branch invariant, cache hook, idempotency)
dotnet test tests/FundingPlatform.Tests.Integration --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ApplicationServiceEditQuotationTests"

# E2E (one class per US)
dotnet test tests/FundingPlatform.Tests.E2E --filter "FullyQualifiedName~QuotationEdit"
```

The E2E suite drives the full journey from the landing page; do **not** deep-link into `Quotation/Edit` for tests — open the application via the UI surface the applicant actually uses (memory `feedback_e2e_must_drive_real_user_journey.md`).
